verification.realtime: GA4 showed 1 active user and the homepage with 1 view, plus standard first_visit/session_start events.
verification.https: Enforcement true; HTTP and www requests end at canonical HTTPS with 200.

limitations: Same AI assistant implemented and verified; no independent review.
Local confirmations for seven guides, fluent language review, physical-device and broader accessibility checks remain separate.
Consent checks used synthetic URL/search markers; no personal journey or contribution content was entered. Cookies and browser storage were not directly inspected.
Realtime includes the synthetic verification visits; those are not organic audience results.
Six native PDF cases were verified before release; published print CSS was checked, without repeating physical-printer or other-browser checks.
